newsitem.title: GERMANY: German SAT1 network expects merchandising growth.
newsitem.headline: German SAT1 network expects merchandising growth.

text.p: Private German television network SAT1 said on Monday its gross merchandising sales had skyrocketed in recent years, multiplying 15 times since 1994 and showed no sign of slowing down.

With 700 products from cigarette lighters to mid-size cars now on the market emblazoned with the network's rainbow-globe logo or characters from popular programmes, SAT1 reported gross retail income of 635 million marks for 1996.
"The products more people are buying are the more expensive ones, which of course helped increase gross income even more," a SAT1 spokeswoman said. "We expect further growth in 1997."
The spokeswoman added the network might branch out to department stores, petrol stations and chemists as retail outlets this year.
SAT1 is also planning to build a housing development in Mallorca and is considering lauching its own savings and investment services, she said.
